Name: AhCuteArt's Color Themed Torches
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]AhCuteArt's Colored Theme Project[/center][/size][/b]

Hi there, everyone! This is one of my entries for the 2026 SDV Modfest. I had a couple of these color-themed projects in the works and figured this was a great time to finish them. I usually post my mods on the weekend, but I plan to drop each mod the minute I finished them. After the contest, I'll go back to my regular schedule. Good luck to everyone who is entering~!

I looked around on Nexus, and I wanted more options for my torches. The goal was to make several cute torches and change the glow color. Unfortunately, it's not possible to change the glow color atm (the code won't allow it). So I did the next best thing and created different colored flames that still match the in-game light color.

[b]Current Colors: Black, Blue, Red, White, Green, Grey, Orange, Purple, Yellow,  Baby Blue, Buttermilk, Lilac, Marigold, Mint, and Pink
[b]Torch Types: Crystal, Cupcake, and Liquid in Glass Bottle[/b]
[/b][b]
[/b]
[b][size=4]INSTALLATION (Must have Content Patcher): [/size]
[/b]
1. ﻿Choose one of the files or both. (Both the CP and AT files work together or separately) 
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]
[size=4]There are Two files:[/size][/b]
[CP File] This file will change all vanilla torches into a themed type and color. Go into the GMCM and look for [b](CP) AhCuteArt Colored Torches[/b] to change whatever options you want. NOTE: You can change color, then set the torch type to none for just a flame color change. Want the festival decor overlay only? Change the color and torch type to none. Don't like the decor showing up on festival days? Turn off Festival Overlay. 

[AT File] This file will change torches into whatever theme and color you want. Make sure to buy the paint bucket from Robin to be able to edit your torches. 

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This should work in every language. (I hope)
[*]Let me know if there is a mod that clashes with mine, and I'll try to fix it. 
[*][b]Flame colors will only change in CP mod. [/b](You can set the torch type to NONE, and only the candle flame will change. )
[/list]
[b][size=4]EXTRA!:[/size][/b]
During the major holidays, little dark fairies will decorate your torches for the Flower, Egg, Luau, Midnight Jellies, Fair, Spirit, Ice, and Star Festivals. (This can be shut off in the GMCM menu)
